caption: The drawing depicts an object made of metal with a predominantly brownish tone and some slight reddish hints, suggesting rust or age. The object consists of an elongated, oval or leaf-shaped main section, within which there are a series of squiggly, zigzag, and straight metal rods arranged in a somewhat symmetrical pattern. Attached to one end of the oval section is a twisted handle that is straight with a loop at the very end, likely for hanging. At the opposite end of the oval, a short L-shaped leg extends downward, suggesting the object is designed to stand or be propped up. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color, with the artist's signature, "Adele Brooks," written below the object in small, neat handwriting.
title: Wrought Iron Broiler
